topic: The Bending Path: Understanding Light Refraction

sections.title: The Hook: The Broken Straw Illusion
lecture_lines: Light normally travels in straight lines.
But watch what happens in water.
animations: Draw a straight line for the straw.
Overlay a broken line segment at an angle.
Highlight the water surface interface with #FFFFFF.
Show light rays bending at the interface.
Label the virtual vs actual position in #FF4500.

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Nature of Light Speed
lecture_lines: Light speed changes in different materials.
Air is fast, water is slower.
animations: Animate light pulse moving from vacuum to glass.
Show pulse slowing down upon entry.
Compare light speed using a speedometer graphic #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Physics of Refraction (Snell’s Law)
lecture_lines: Light slows and bends toward it.
animations: Draw an incident ray with label i in #FFD700.
Draw a refracted ray with label r in #00FF00.
Flash the variables to emphasize change.

sections.title: Real-World Application: Predator Precision
lecture_lines: Objects appear deeper than they are.
Aim lower to hit the target.
animations: Draw an archerfish looking upward from underwater.
Animate the prey image projected above the surface.
Show the path of the water jet.

sections.title: Summary and Concept Check
animations: List the key concepts appearing on screen.
Highlight the relationship between speed and bending.
Show the refraction formula one final time.
